pages.title: Place Block
pages.text:
$(l)slotReference, vec3 -> Place Block$()
Parameter order doesn't matter
Takes one block item from specified slot, attempts to place at target coordinate. If position is replaceable (air, plants, etc.), placement succeeds. $(br)$(br)Mana cost: 2

pages.title: Water
pages.text:
vec3 -> Water ->
Pops coordinate, places water source at that position.

Mana cost: 15
Can only replace air or replaceable blocks.
